title: The same failing call is refused after the bound, then the turn stops (Spanish)
pins: A model that keeps asking for the same call that fails the same way: it runs until it has failed 3 times, is then refused without running ({executed: false} says why), and about 10 identical attempts end the turn as a model failure instead of using up the allowance. From the 0.18.0 changelog (bots/repeat_guard.py).

steps.message: ¿Qué recuerdas de mis preferencias de viaje?
